component.name: deepDesign Studio
component.summary: AI 原生原型设计工具

description.p: deepDesign Studio is a Tauri 2 desktop client for AI-native prototyping, powered by the pure-MoonBit MoonViz engine: the .mbt.md document is the single source of truth; both human canvas edits and Agent changes pass engine validation before writing back.
deepDesign Studio 是 AI 原生原型设计工具的桌面客户端（Tauri 2）。基于纯 MoonBit 引擎 MoonViz：唯一事实源是 .mbt.md 文档，人类画布操作与 Agent 修改都必须经引擎校验后回写同一文档。
